name: veritas-085418 — the captured fight, cast by cast
note: ⚠ The capture is a WINDOW of a fight already in progress, not a fight from its start: 1409's 「雨过天晴」 is up before event 0 (1415's 生命上限 10320.4433 already carries it, per AGENT.md §3.7k), and 1413's own 生命面板 moves inside the window (2960.0287 → 4526.4984 → 4309.8792). Those prefix states are NOT reproducible by driving this window, so they are declared missing in AGENT.md rather than invented here. What this plan states is what the payload itself states: each enemy's 生命上限 / 防御 / 抗性, and which skill slot each captured cast used. ⚠ The party's panels are NOT written here any more: each member states its `cid` + the light cone it wears, and the panel is COMPUTED by the engine (base row + level + cone + the account dump's relics + traces) - that derivation is itself part of what the replay proves (judge `PanelFromDumpTest`: the computed ATTACK/DEFENCE equal the capture's own panel to 1e-6 relative). The capture's per-cast panel is still installed at each cast, because it moves inside the window (1413's life 2960 → 4526 → 4309) and no replay can earn that. The cast → slot table is the manual part ( §4 of the handover ): attack_type 12 is a 忆灵's skill, and a 忆灵's skills live by DATA SLOT, so each entry names the slot and the memosprite it belongs to.

casts.note: 长夜's 忆灵技1「追忆，蹁跹，如雨」: six instances on one target (skill_segments.json servants.11413 Skill01 = 6, main=6), ice, base 0.06 x 生命上限 each = the game's 5 x 0.1 + 1 x 0.5 split of one 0.6 row.

小伊卡's 忆灵技1「乌云乌云快走开！」: the damage is DELIVERED BY RULES (11409/1 is effect Rules -> 1409's own rule reads the 累计治疗 tally), which expands to every living enemy - the capture shows two targets because the rule/attack reaches all of them.

Same slot as cast 1. The capture's per-instance base is 0.09 x 生命上限 = 0.9 for the whole cast, i.e. 0.6 + the 「每有 #3 点【忆质】额外造成 #2%」 the game folds into the same six instances (AGENT.md §3.7h; the fold is now implemented - skill_effects.json's resource_share). The ten points are DERIVED, not guessed: (0.09 - 0.06) x 4 / 0.12 = 10 at the Lv8 row. They are declared here because a replay that starts from zero only earns the one point cast 1 granted - the window's prefix is state the payload never carries.
1413's own ultimate (attack_type 3): a 15-level AoE row, base 2.0 x 生命上限 on each enemy.

「迷梦，流失，如露」(1141307, SkillTriggerKey Skill11 - the servant's slots are SkillID % 100, so this is data slot 7; the old 'slot_guess 8' was the guess and no slot 8 exists upstream). The text (TextMap 7843681538325136114) prices the hit PER POINT of 忆质 - main target #1, every other enemy #2 - and then 「施放后，消耗全部【忆质】和生命值，并使「长夜」消失」. The capture's 3.0000000028 (main) and 1.5000000014 (other) are 0.06 x 50 and 0.03 x 50: fifty points at the Lv1 row (Lv10 would need 17.857 points, which is not a whole number). The fifty are the window's prefix and are declared here for the same reason cast 4's ten are - a replay that starts empty has only what the window earned.
1415's basic attack (attack_type 1), base 0.5 x 生命上限 - her row states its damage off Max HP, not ATK.
小伊卡 again, after more healing raised the tally.
1413's ultimate, one living target this time.

德谬歌's 忆灵技1 (skill_segments.json servants.11415 = one hit per cast), base 0.6 x 生命上限. The flow groups four consecutive same-actor same-type hits as one cast; the segment table says each cast is ONE hit, so this entry is driven four times.

晴空乐手's 忆灵技1: the share is 11512 slot 1's SECOND parameter (the row's #1 is 0 at every level). ✅ Read from #2 - skill_effects.json declares it via damage_parts[].index (judge SummerSongbirdSkillOneTest) - and ✅ the multiplier applies to the SUMMONER's Max HP (Summon.damageBase; AGENT.md 3.7ze), so at this cast's Lv6 row the base is 1.5 x 5249.7811 = 7874.67 and the engine reproduces it.
